register.title: Evan Daniel's exact descents of public Kaggle packings at 268 and 304, at 8a8879a, no issue
register.headline: Daniel's exact descents of public Kaggle packings at 268 and 304, below the reports before them
register.source_checks: Each certificate's JSON report states it valid (cert_valid) at 80 digits, its least wall and pair clearances (5e-21 and about 1e-20), and S_exact, the side of a Newton-converged KKT point of the descent. The certificates' headers name the source's verify_cert.py, byte-identical to the copy the n183 packet retains. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here. From the two sides it states, the certificate's side lies above S_exact by about 1.7e-19 at 268 and 1.8e-19 at 304, a relative padding of 1e-20.
register.credit: Credit at 268 Vladislav Lavrentev's public Kaggle packing, as the source credits it: 'Vladislav Lavrentev's (Kaggle lightningv08) public packing, exact descent (shrink-only) to 16.8743617159, the side a Kaggle per-puzzle side-only claim lists; the first public packing at that side'; and at 304 'the public Kaggle packing at 17.9268989004 (finder unknown; earliest public copy: kozykappa's notebook)', which Francisco Couzo's earlier certificate of the same packing (T-241) credits to Kirill Tymchishin's Kaggle notebook 'CPU Alternating Reclosure' v3; no source states where that notebook started (M-1 of the 24 October stage 4 review). Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing) descended each exactly to the side stated and wrote the certificate. The source's credits say its work was produced by Claude (Anthropic) under human direction.
register.next_rung: None for the bound. V4 and C4 need a second accepted adversarial review by a distinct reviewer and a retained human oversight record. Both counts are the smallest validated sides and are adopted under the house rule: 304 in the pass that maps the review, and 268 in the next pull request, since the pass of 25 October already moved 268.

bibliography.note: Two complete exact certificates at 8a8879a2972c32cbd2d906049228cc9f0762b02a, pushed on 24 October 2026 with no issue: s(268) <= 8437180857934672912242411148233/(5*10^29), the exact descent of Vladislav Lavrentev's public Kaggle packing (lightningv08), and s(304) <= 1792689890035674158972360842897/10^29, the exact descent of a public Kaggle packing whose finder the source does not know, which Francisco Couzo's fa6237e certificate credits to Kirill Tymchishin. For these descents the source names nothing of this project's beyond the comparison its _prior.json files draw from the register, and its CREDITS.md lists the Squares Project as parallel work, so the key is independent and credits no Levy link (M-4 of the 24 October review). The source did not post them, since issue 763 already held the counts. A third, Chris Deotte's packing at 303, is above #763's and retained as credit evidence only. MIT-licensed; Claude assistance disclosed. The KKT statements are the author's; no local or global optimality claim.
